title: Derivative of a finite-field monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. For every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the Boolean derivative of the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$ in direction $y$ equals $\displaystyle\sum_{T\subsetneq S}\left(\prod_{i\in T}x_i\right)\left(\prod_{i\in S\setminus T}y_i\right)$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
hypotheses_covered: A subset S of the n coordinates
A direction y in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
